qe: Which native polysaccharide functions as the primary metabolic energy storage macromolecule localized within the liver and skeletal muscle tissues of animals?
qh: कौन सा प्राकृतिक पॉलीसेकेराइड जानवरों के यकृत (liver) और कंकाल की मांसपेशियों के ऊतकों के भीतर स्थानीयकृत प्राथमिक चयापचय ऊर्जा भंडारण मैक्रोमोलेक्यूल के रूप में कार्य करता है?
e: Explanation: Glycogen is a highly branched polymer of glucose that serves as the primary storage carbohydrate in animals, found in high concentrations within the liver, muscles, and brain. Conversely, cellulose is exclusive to plant cell walls, while amylose and amylopectin constitute starch.

qe: Why are cellulose nitrate and cellulose acetate formally categorized as semi-synthetic polymers rather than purely synthetic or purely natural materials?
qh: सेलुलोज नाइट्रेट और सेलुलोज एसीटेट को विशुद्ध रूप से सिंथेटिक या विशुद्ध रूप से प्राकृतिक सामग्रियों के बजाय औपचारिक रूप से अर्ध-सिंथेटिक पॉलिमर (semi-synthetic polymers) के रूप में क्यों वर्गीकृत किया जाता है?
o: They are derived by taking a natural polymer baseline and introducing chemical modifications in a laboratory
They are synthesized entirely from petroleum-derived volatile monomers
They completely lack covalent bonds across their functional backbones
They undergo spontaneous biochemical replication inside plant tissues
e: Explanation: Semi-synthetic polymers are produced by chemically modifying naturally occurring polymers. Cellulose nitrate and cellulose acetate are derived by chemically treating natural cellulose, whereas vulcanized rubber is derived from natural rubber.

qe: What are the common commercial or trade designations assigned to the addition polymer Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) in the textile industry?
qh: कपड़ा उद्योग में एडिशन पॉलिमर पॉलीएक्रिलोनाइट्राइल (PAN) को कौन से सामान्य व्यावसायिक या व्यापारिक नाम दिए गए हैं?
e: Explanation: Polyacrylonitrile (PAN) is synthesized via the addition polymerization of acrylonitrile in the presence of a peroxide catalyst. Industrially, this material is commercialized under the trade names Orlon or Acrilan and serves as a synthetic wool substitute.

qe: Which environmental and structural property highlights the primary advantage of utilizing PHBV over standard commercial polyolefins?
qh: कौन सा पर्यावरणीय और संरचनात्मक गुण मानक वाणिज्यिक पॉलीओलेफिन की तुलना में PHBV का उपयोग करने के प्राथमिक लाभ पर प्रकाश डालता है?
o: It is completely non-biodegradable and persists in water systems indefinitely
It is a highly effective broad-spectrum antibiotic matrix
It undergoes smooth ecological decomposition because it is a biodegradable copolymer
It consists entirely of inorganic quaternary ammonium salts
e: Explanation: Poly $\beta$-hydroxybutyrate-co-$\beta$-hydroxyvalerate (PHBV) is a specialized copolymer composed of 3-hydroxybutanoic acid and 3-hydroxypentanoic acid. Because of its ester linkages, it is entirely biodegradable and cleanly decomposes in the environment.

qe: During the industrial synthesis of the polyester known commercially as Dacron or Terylene, which diol monomer is condensed alongside a dicarboxylic acid?
qh: डैक्रॉन या टेरिलीन के रूप में व्यावसायिक रूप से जाने जाने वाले पॉलिएस्टर के औद्योगिक संश्लेषण के दौरान, किस डायोल मोनोमर को डायकारबॉक्सिलिक एसिड के साथ संघनित किया जाता है?
e: Explanation: Dacron (Terylene) is generated via the condensation polymerization of ethylene glycol and terephthalic acid (or phthalic acid variants) at an optimized temperature range of 420-460 K using catalysts like zinc acetate and antimony trioxide.

qe: Which architectural characteristic accurately describes the macromolecular structure of Low-Density Polyethylene (LDPE)?
qh: कौन सी संरचनात्मक विशेषता कम घनत्व वाले पॉलीथीन (LDPE) की मैक्रोमोलेक्यूलर संरचना का सटीक वर्णन करती है?
o: A rigid, heavily cross-linked three-dimensional structural network
A linear chain network exhibiting slight to moderate branching configurations
A completely unbranched, highly crystalline linear framework
An open-chain dibasic dicarboxylic acid lattice configuration
e: Explanation: Low-Density Polyethylene (LDPE) is structurally distinguished by its moderately branched polymer network. This branching prevents the chains from packing closely together, rendering the material tough, flexible, and a poor conductor of electricity, but not completely unbranched or highly cross-linked.

qe: The addition polymer displaying the repeating backbone component $[-CH_2-C(CH_3)_2-]_n$ is generated by compiling which specific alkene monomer?
qh: आवर्ती रीढ़ घटक $[-CH_2-C(CH_3)_2-]_n$ को प्रदर्शित करने वाला एडिशन पॉलिमर किस विशिष्ट एल्कीन मोनोमर को संकलित करके उत्पन्न होता है?
e: Explanation: The polymer polyisobutylene, which contains the repeating structural block $[-CH_2-C(CH_3)_2-]_n$, is produced via the addition polymerization of 2-methylpropene (commonly referred to as isobutylene) monomers.

qe: The industrial ring-opening polymerization of the cyclic amide monomer caprolactam yields which high-tensile poly-amide material?
qh: चक्रीय एमाइड मोनोमर कैप्रोलैक्टम का औद्योगिक रिंग-ओपनिंग पॉलीमराइजेशन किस उच्च-तन्यता वाले पॉली-एमाइड सामग्री को उत्पन्न करता है?
e: Explanation: Caprolactam is a seven-membered cyclic lactam. Upon thermal polymerization accompanied by ring-opening structural cleavage, it compiles into the linear polyamide known as Nylon-6.

qe: Which class of chemical building blocks must be included in the starting monomer pool to synthesize elastomers like Buna-S and Neoprene?
qh: ब्यूना-एस और नियोप्रीन जैसे इलास्टोमर्स को संश्लेषित करने के लिए शुरुआती मोनोमर पूल में रासायनिक बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक्स के किस वर्ग को शामिल किया जाना चाहिए?
e: Explanation: Elastomers like Buna-S and Neoprene require at least one conjugated diene monomer. Buna-S is synthesized by copolymerizing 1,3-butadiene (a diene) with styrene, while Neoprene is produced by the addition polymerization of chloroprene (2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene).

qe: Why do thermosetting polymers permanently lose their ability to be recycled or reshaped after their initial thermal molding run?
qh: थर्मोसेटिंग पॉलिमर अपने प्रारंभिक थर्मल मोल्डिंग रन के बाद पुनर्नवीनीकरण (recycled) या पुनर्जीवित होने की अपनी क्षमता को स्थायी रूप से क्यों खो देते हैं?
o: They separate into highly volatile gaseous monomers at room temperature
They form extensive, irreversible cross-linked three-dimensional networks that remain infusible upon reheating
They convert into water-soluble linear oligomers when cooled
They lack covalent chemical bonds across their structural domains
e: Explanation: Thermosetting polymers (e.g., Bakelite, urea-formaldehyde resins) develop heavily branched cross-linked networks when heated in molds. This extensive chemical cross-linking makes them infusible and insoluble, meaning they cannot be softened, reshaped, or reused upon reheating.

qe: Which pair of commercial polymers are linear or slightly branched long-chain molecules that soften reversibly upon heating, classifying them as thermoplastics?
qh: वाणिज्यिक पॉलिमर की कौन सी जोड़ी रैखिक या थोड़े शाखित लंबी श्रृंखला वाले अणु हैं जो गर्म करने पर प्रतिवर्ती रूप से (reversibly) नरम हो जाते हैं, जिससे उन्हें थर्मोप्लास्टिक्स के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया जाता है?
e: Explanation: Thermoplastics are linear or slightly branched long-chain molecules that can be repeatedly softened by heating and hardened by cooling without altering their chemical composition. Examples include Teflon (PTFE) and Polystyrene.

qe: What structural feature enables polymers like Nylon and Terylene to be processed into high-efficiency industrial fibers?
qh: कौन सी संरचनात्मक विशेषता नायलॉन और टेरिलीन जैसे पॉलिमर को उच्च दक्षता वाले औद्योगिक फाइबर में संसाधित करने में सक्षम बनाती है?
o: Weak van der Waals dispersion forces that maximize stretching
Strong intermolecular forces such as Hydrogen bonding or dipole-dipole interactions that optimize close chain packing
The total presence of positive quaternary ammonium centers
Highly volatile ester linkages that evaporate under pressure
e: Explanation: Fibers are polymers characterized by strong intermolecular forces of attraction, such as hydrogen bonding (in polyamides like Nylon) or strong dipole-dipole interactions (in polyesters like Terylene). These forces lead to tight chain packing, imparting high tensile strength and crystalline properties.

qe: Which mechanism details the assembly of addition polymers like Orlon and Polystyrene from their respective building blocks?
qh: कौन सा तंत्र ऑरलॉन और पॉलीस्टायरीन जैसे एडिशन पॉलिमर के उनके संबंधित बिल्डिंग ब्लॉक्स से संकलन का विवरण देता है?
o: The elimination of small byproducts like water or ammonia from bi-functional reagents
The repeated addition of monomer units possessing double or triple bonds without the loss of any secondary molecular fragments
The ring-opening cleavage of highly stable saturated lactam frameworks
The complete oxidation of glucose structures using concentrated nitric acid
e: Explanation: Addition polymers are formed by the repetitive linking of monomers containing unsaturated double or triple bonds without forming any low-molecular-weight byproducts. Orlon is produced from acrylonitrile, and Polystyrene is produced from styrene via addition mechanisms.

qe: Which pair of polymers are synthesized via repeated condensation reactions between poly-functional monomer units, releasing low-molecular-weight byproducts like water?
qh: पॉलिमर की कौन सी जोड़ी पॉली-कार्यात्मक मोनोमर इकाइयों के बीच बार-बार संघनित (condensation) प्रतिक्रियाओं के माध्यम से संश्लेषित होती है, जिससे पानी जैसे कम आणविक भार वाले उप-उत्पाद निकलते हैं?
e: Explanation: Condensation polymers are generated through step-growth reactions between bi-functional or tri-functional monomers, accompanied by the systematic elimination of small fragments such as $H_2O$, alcohols, or $HCl$. Examples include Bakelite and Melamine-formaldehyde resin.

qe: Which monomer pair is condensed together to synthesize the synthetic biodegradable polymer known as Nylon-2-nylon-6?
qh: नायलॉन-2-नायलॉन-6 के रूप में जाने जाने वाले सिंथेटिक बायोडिग्रेडेबल पॉलिमर को संश्लेषित करने के लिए किस मोनोमर जोड़ी को एक साथ संघनित किया जाता है?
e: Explanation: Nylon-2-nylon-6 is an alternating biodegradable polyamide copolymer produced via the condensation polymerization of glycine ($H_2N-CH_2-COOH$) and aminocaproic acid ($H_2N-(CH_2)_5-COOH$).

qe: Which pair of synthetic elastomeric compounds are categorized as synthetic rubbers under industrial manufacturing standards?
qh: औद्योगिक विनिर्माण मानकों के तहत किन सिंथेटिक इलास्टोमेरिक यौगिकों की जोड़ी को सिंथेटिक रबर के रूप में वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
e: Explanation: Synthetic rubbers are engineered elastomers produced in laboratories or chemical plants. Polychloroprene (Neoprene, made from chloroprene) and Buna-N (copolymerized from 1,3-butadiene and acrylonitrile) are classic examples of synthetic rubbers.

qe: What macromolecular classification describes a material composed of unsaturated hydrocarbon tails cross-linked by sulfur bridges during thermal processing?
qh: कौन सा मैक्रोमोलेक्यूलर वर्गीकरण उस सामग्री का वर्णन करता है जो थर्मल प्रोसेसिंग के दौरान सल्फर पुलों द्वारा क्रॉस-लिंक्ड असंतृप्त हाइड्रोकार्बन पूंछ से बनी होती है?
e: Explanation: Vulcanization involves heating raw rubber alongside sulfur agents. This introduces stable cross-linkages across the unsaturated polymer strands, transforming the sticky material into vulcanized rubber, which is significantly stiffer, stronger, and more elastic.

qe: What structural criteria must monomers meet to undergo classic vinylic addition polymerization to yield compounds like Acrilan and Polystyrene?
qh: एकलकों को शास्त्रीय विनाइलिक जोड़ पॉलीमराइजेशन (vinylic addition polymerization) से गुजरने के लिए किन संरचनात्मक मानदंडों को पूरा करना चाहिए ताकि एक्रिलन और पॉलीस्टायरीन जैसे यौगिक प्राप्त हो सकें?
o: They must be cyclic lactams with an internal amide bond
They must possess an unsaturated vinyl group ($CH_2=CH-X$) capable of free-radical chain propagation
They must be bi-functional aromatic dialcohols
They must display open-chain dibasic dicarboxylic frameworks
e: Explanation: Vinylic monomers contain an unsaturated carbon-carbon double bond configuration ($CH_2=CH-X$). Reagents like acrylonitrile (for Acrilan), styrene (for Polystyrene), and tetrafluoroethylene (for Teflon) possess this vinylic grouping, allowing for free-radical chain expansion.

qe: How do sulfide linkages established during vulcanization alter the physical properties of raw natural rubber?
qh: वल्कनीकरण के दौरान स्थापित सल्फाइड लिंकेज कच्चे प्राकृतिक रबर के भौतिक गुणों को कैसे बदलते हैं?
o: They make the rubber matrix highly water-soluble and chemically unstable
They render the rubber more elastic, structurally stiffer, and mechanically stronger
They convert the hydrocarbon chains into open-chain saccharic acids
They remove all covalent bonds to make the material volatile
e: Explanation: Introducing sulfur cross-links between polyisoprene chains forms stable bridges. These linkages anchor the strands, preventing them from slipping past each other irreversibly, thereby rendering the material stiffer, stronger, and significantly more elastic.

qe: Why does starch fail to function as a structural cell wall component in plants, whereas its isomer cellulose excels?
qh: स्टार्च पौधों में एक संरचनात्मक कोशिका भित्ति घटक (structural cell wall component) के रूप में कार्य करने में क्यों विफल रहता है, जबकि इसका आइसोमर सेलुलोज उत्कृष्ट है?
o: Starch consists of highly volatile ester fragments that evaporate at room temperature
Starch is optimized strictly as a branched or coiled metabolic energy reserve, whereas cellulose forms rigid, linear unbranched chains tailored for structural strength
Starch contains a high concentration of toxic arsenic linkages
Starch completely lacks oxygen atoms within its organic matrix
e: Explanation: Starch (composed of amylose and amylopectin) is configured for quick enzymatic cleavage and energy storage. Cellulose forms linear, unbranched $\beta$-glucose chains that pack closely into fibrous bundles stabilized by hydrogen bonding, providing structural integrity to cell walls.

qe: Which processing chemical is reacted with natural cellulose to manufacture the semi-synthetic thermoplastic sheet known as cellulose acetate?
qh: सेलुलोज एसीटेट के रूप में जाने जाने वाले अर्ध-सिंथेटिक थर्मोप्लास्टिक शीट के निर्माण के लिए प्राकृतिक सेलुलोज के साथ किस प्रसंस्करण रसायन की प्रतिक्रिया की जाती है?
e: Explanation: Acetylating natural cellulose fibers with acetic anhydride or acetic acid in the presence of a catalyst replaces hydroxyl groups with acetate groups, converting the natural substrate into semi-synthetic cellulose acetate.

qe: What catalytic condition initiates the swift chain propagation of acrylonitrile into polyacrylonitrile during industrial manufacturing?
qh: औद्योगिक विनिर्माण के दौरान पॉलीएक्रिलोनाइट्राइल में एक्रिलोनाइट्राइल के तेजी से श्रृंखला प्रसार (chain propagation) को कौन सी उत्प्रेरक स्थिति शुरू करती है?
o: An aqueous strong basic mineral buffer
e: Explanation: Synthesizing polyacrylonitrile (PAN) from acrylonitrile requires a free-radical mechanism initiated by a peroxide catalyst, which breaks the monomeric $\pi$-bonds to drive chain propagation.

qe: What happens to the structure of the cyclic monomer caprolactam when it is heated with water to generate Nylon-6?
qh: जब चक्रीय मोनोमर कैप्रोलैक्टम को नायलॉन-6 उत्पन्न करने के लिए पानी के साथ गर्म किया जाता है तो उसकी संरचना का क्या होता है?
o: It cross-links into a three-dimensional thermosetting network containing methylene bridges
It undergoes hydrolytic ring-opening cleavage to yield an open amino acid chain that polymerizes into a polyamide
It undergoes oxidation into a dibasic dicarboxylic acid fragment
It forms insoluble precipitates via the common-ion effect
e: Explanation: Heating caprolactam with water at elevated temperatures breaks its internal cyclic amide bond. This ring-opening hydrolytic step yields $\varepsilon$-aminocaproic acid, which polymerizes into the linear polyamide chain of Nylon-6.

qe: Which physical attribute distinguishes Low-Density Polyethylene (LDPE) from High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE)?
qh: कौन सी भौतिक विशेषता कम घनत्व वाले पॉलीथीन (LDPE) को उच्च घनत्व वाले पॉलीथीन (HDPE) से अलग करती है?
o: LDPE forms an entirely crystalline network stabilized by amide links
LDPE contains short-chain branching that limits close packing, whereas HDPE features a linear, tightly packed structure
LDPE undergoes rapid biodegradation in environmental water systems
LDPE is a superior thermal conductor due to its cross-linked framework
e: Explanation: LDPE production involves high pressures that induce radical branching along the backbone. This structural branching prevents close chain packing, resulting in a lower density, lower crystallinity, and higher flexibility compared to the highly linear structure of HDPE.

qe: Which specific organic compound is copolymerized alongside 1,3-butadiene to manufacture the high-durability elastomer Buna-S?
qh: उच्च-स्थायित्व वाले इलास्टोमर ब्यूना-एस के निर्माण के लिए 1,3-ब्यूटाडाइन के साथ किस विशिष्ट कार्बनिक यौगिक को कोपॉलीमराइज़ किया जाता है?
e: Explanation: Buna-S rubber is an addition copolymer produced by compiling 1,3-butadiene ($CH_2=CH-CH=CH_2$) and styrene ($C_6H_5-CH=CH_2$) under free-radical conditions initiated by sodium (Na) or peroxides.

qe: What type of intermolecular attraction stabilizes the long chains of synthetic fibers like Nylon-6,6, preventing deformation under heavy loads?
qh: नायलॉन-6,6 जैसे सिंथेटिक फाइबर की लंबी श्रृंखलाओं को किस प्रकार का अंतर-आणविक आकर्षण स्थिर करता है, जिससे भारी भार के तहत विकृति (deformation) रुकती है?
o: Weak van der Waals dispersion matrices
Extensive inter-chain Hydrogen bonding between amide functional groups
Reversible ester links that break at room temperature
e: Explanation: The mechanical strength of polyamides like Nylon-6,6 stems from extensive inter-chain hydrogen bonding between polar carbonyl oxygen atoms ($C=O$) and amine hydrogen atoms ($N-H$) along adjacent chains, which optimizes crystal packing.

qe: Which structural feature prevents a thermoplastic material from permanently hardening when exposed to high processing temperatures?
qh: कौन सी संरचनात्मक विशेषता एक थर्मोप्लास्टिक सामग्री को उच्च प्रसंस्करण तापमान के संपर्क में आने पर स्थायी रूप से कठोर होने से रोकती है?
o: The total lack of any cross-linked chemical covalent bonds between the linear polymer strands
The complete conversion of carbon atoms into uncharged ether links
The automatic synthesis of biodegradable ester bridges upon heating
The presence of toxic arsenic-arsenic links across its domains
e: Explanation: Thermoplastics consist of linear or moderately branched polymer chains held together by weak intermolecular forces. Because they lack permanent covalent cross-links between individual strands, heating allows the chains to slide past one another fluidly, resulting in reversible melting.

qe: What specific class of synthetic materials is generated when bi-functional monomer units react alongside the release of water or alcohol byproducts?
qh: जब द्वि-कार्यात्मक मोनोमर इकाइयाँ पानी या अल्कोहल उप-उत्पादों के निकलने के साथ प्रतिक्रिया करती हैं तो सिंथेटिक सामग्रियों का कौन सा विशिष्ट वर्ग उत्पन्न होता है?
e: Explanation: Condensation polymerization involves step-growth interactions between poly-functional monomers containing reactive groups (like $-COOH$, $-OH$, or $-NH_2$). Each linking step releases low-molecular-weight fragments, such as water or alcohols.

qe: What organic starting materials are condensed to synthesize the hard, scratch-resistant thermosetting polymer used in shatterproof dinnerware?
qh: अटूट डिनरवेयर में उपयोग किए जाने वाले कठोर, खरोंच-प्रतिरोधी थर्मोसेटिंग पॉलिमर को संश्लेषित करने के लिए कौन सी कार्बनिक प्रारंभिक सामग्री संघनित की जाती है?
e: Explanation: Melamine-formaldehyde resin is a durable thermoset synthesized by condensing melamine and formaldehyde. It forms an expansive cross-linked network ideal for manufacturing break-resistant plastic crockery.

qe: What happens to the relative percentage of sulfur introduced into a rubber matrix during industrial vulcanization processing?
qh: औद्योगिक वल्कनीकरण प्रसंस्करण के दौरान रबर मैट्रिक्स में पेश किए गए सल्फर का सापेक्ष प्रतिशत क्या होता है?
o: It must be kept precisely at zero to avoid structural collapse
Varying the sulfur concentration allows chemical technicians to tune the stiffness, ranging from flexible rubber bands to hard structural ebonite
It turns into gaseous ammonia that leaves the framework completely
It converts the material into a linear non-ionic detergent configuration
e: Explanation: Adjusting the sulfur concentration during vulcanization controls cross-linking density. Low sulfur levels ($1-3\%$) preserve flexibility for items like rubber bands, whereas higher sulfur levels ($30\%$) create dense cross-links, producing rigid ebonite.

qe: Which polymer features a halogenated vinyl backbone configuration ($[-CF_2-CF_2-]_n$) that accounts for its excellent chemical inertness?
qh: किस पॉलिमर में हैलोजनयुक्त विनाइल रीढ़ विन्यास ($[-CF_2-CF_2-]_n$) होता है जो इसकी उत्कृष्ट रासायनिक निष्क्रियता के लिए जिम्मेदार है?
e: Explanation: Polytetrafluoroethylene (Teflon) contains dense carbon-fluorine ($C-F$) bonds that are highly stable and resist chemical attack, providing excellent thermal stability and chemical resistance.

qe: What descriptive term classifies the structural mechanism by which Orlon and Polystyrene are formed from their unsaturated monomer reagents?
qh: कौन सा वर्णनात्मक शब्द उस संरचनात्मक तंत्र को वर्गीकृत करता है जिसके द्वारा ऑरलॉन और पॉलीस्टायरीन उनके असंतृप्त मोनोमर अभिकर्मकों से बनते हैं?
e: Explanation: Orlon and Polystyrene are formed via chain-growth addition polymerization. This process involves the sequential addition of unsaturated monomer units across double bonds, driven by active free-radical centers without releasing small byproducts.

qe: The synthetic copolymer known as PHBV is structurally categorized under which family of macromolecular materials?
qh: PHBV के रूप में जाने जाने वाले सिंथेटिक कोपोलिमर को संरचनात्मक रूप से मैक्रोमोलेक्यूलर सामग्रियों के किस परिवार के तहत वर्गीकृत किया गया है?
e: Explanation: PHBV is a biodegradable polyester composed of ester-linked 3-hydroxybutanoic acid and 3-hydroxypentanoic acid segments, which are readily cleaved by environmental microbial enzymes.

qe: Which operational catalyst combo is deployed alongside a high thermal range (420-460 K) to drive the industrial synthesis of commercial Terylene?
qh: वाणिज्यिक टेरिलीन के औद्योगिक संश्लेषण को चलाने के लिए उच्च तापीय सीमा (420-460 K) के साथ कौन सा परिचालन उत्प्रेरक कॉम्बो तैनात किया जाता है?
o: Concentrated sulfuric acid and liquid nitrogen
Sodium metal and fuming nitric acid
Peroxide radicals and ammonia gas solvents
e: Explanation: Transforming ethylene glycol and terephthalic acid into Terylene (Dacron) requires temperatures between 420-460 K and a specific catalyst system, such as zinc acetate and antimony trioxide.

qe: What linear intermediate condensation product is synthesized during the initial reaction of phenol and formaldehyde under acidic catalysis?
qh: अम्लीय उत्प्रेरण के तहत फिनोल और फॉर्मलाडेहाइड की प्रारंभिक प्रतिक्रिया के दौरान कौन सा रैखिक मध्यवर्ती संघनन उत्पाद (linear intermediate condensation product) संश्लेषित होता है?
e: Explanation: Controlling the initial reaction of phenol and formaldehyde under acidic conditions yields Novolac, a linear polymer used primarily in commercial paints and varnishes. Further heating with cross-linking agents converts it into Bakelite.

qe: Which structural descriptor details the architectural arrangement of a pristine sample of natural rubber harvested from trees?
qh: कौन सा संरचनात्मक विवरण पेड़ों से काटे गए प्राकृतिक रबर के एक प्राचीन नमूने की स्थापत्य व्यवस्था का विवरण देता है?
e: Explanation: Natural rubber is a linear homopolymer composed of repeating isoprene units arranged in an all-cis-1,4-polyisoprene configuration. This geometry forms coiled molecular structures that impart natural elasticity.

qe: What happens to the internal mechanical performance of raw rubber if it undergoes complete chemical cross-linking with sulfur at high temperatures?
qh: यदि कच्चे रबर को उच्च तापमान पर सल्फर के साथ पूर्ण रासायनिक क्रॉस-लिंकिंग के अधीन किया जाए तो उसके आंतरिक यांत्रिक प्रदर्शन का क्या होता है?
o: It becomes highly water-soluble and breaks down rapidly
Its structural stiffness and elasticity improve significantly while its tackiness and temperature sensitivity decrease
It undergoes rapid conversion into a gaseous state configuration
It loses its covalent chemical bonds entirely across its domains
e: Explanation: Sulfur cross-linking (vulcanization) anchors the polymer chains, significantly reducing structural stickiness and water absorption while improving stiffness, tensile strength, and elasticity across wide temperature ranges.

qe: The addition copolymer known as Buna-N is industrially compiled using which specific monomer ratio combo?
qh: ब्यूना-एन के रूप में जाने जाने वाले एडिशन कोपोलिमर को औद्योगिक रूप से किस विशिष्ट मोनोमर अनुपात कॉम्बो का उपयोग करके संकलित किया जाता है?
e: Explanation: Buna-N rubber is synthesized via the emulsion copolymerization of 1,3-butadiene and acrylonitrile, typically configured in an approximate 3:1 ratio (75% butadiene and 25% acrylonitrile).

qe: What synthetic addition homopolymer is generated by polymerizing 2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene monomers under free-radical conditions?
qh: मुक्त-कण (free-radical) स्थितियों के तहत 2-क्लोरोब्यूटा-1,3-डाईन मोनोमर्स को पॉलीमराइज़ करके कौन सा सिंथेटिक एडिशन होमोपॉलिमर उत्पन्न होता है?
e: Explanation: Neoprene (polychloroprene) is a synthetic rubber produced by the addition polymerization of chloroprene (2-chlorobuta-1,3-diene) monomers, providing high resistance to oils, chemicals, and environmental weathering.

qe: Which structural feature explains why fibers like Nylon exhibit crisp, definitive melting points and high crystallization tendencies?
qh: कौन सी संरचनात्मक विशेषता यह बताती है कि नायलॉन जैसे फाइबर स्पष्ट, निश्चित पिघलने बिंदु और उच्च क्रिस्टलीकरण प्रवृत्तियों को क्यों प्रदर्शित करते हैं?
o: They contain weak van der Waals dispersion interactions between long alkyl tails
They feature highly regular linear backbones anchored by strong, symmetrical inter-chain hydrogen bonds
They consist entirely of random, amorphous highly branched carbohydrate strands
They lose their covalent networks when exposed to ambient moisture
e: Explanation: The linear backbone and symmetrical arrangement of polar amide functional groups in polyamides like Nylon enable close chain packing. This alignment creates strong, repeating inter-chain hydrogen bonds that drive high crystallinity and distinct thermal melting points.
